plain: Coming before in time or place.

webster.text: Before in time or place; prior; antecedent; preceding in time.

more.text: Before or in front in place.

example.quote: In this it has been shown that he is mistaken, as it was not finally ratified till March, 1781, and, anterior to that ratification.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 4, South Carolina House of Representatives (debate on calling the convention), Gen. CHARLES COTESWORTH, January 18, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
